name: Jungle Queen

features.name: Butterfly multiplier
features.description: Collect butterflies to raise the free spins multiplier.

features.name: Symbol removal
features.description: Each level removes the lowest symbol and adds three spins.

review:
A 20-line jungle ruled by a generous goddess. Mystery butterflies and instant Golden Queen coins worth up to 2,500x keep the base game ticking over.

The free spins are clever: you start at 1x, and every time you collect enough butterflies the multiplier goes up by one, the lowest-paying symbol disappears for the rest of the round, and you get three more spins. So the reels get richer the longer the bonus runs. High volatility, 10,000x max, 96.15% RTP, bonus about once every 219 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
